glsa.title: ca-certificates: Compromised Intermediate Certificate Authority
glsa.synopsis: A vulnerability has been discovered in ca-certificates where an intermediate Certificate Authority has been compromised.

background.p: For more information on the packages listed in this GLSA, please see their homepage referenced in the ebuild.

description.p: A vulnerability has been discovered in ca-certificates. Please review the CVE identifier referenced below for details.

impact.p: Man-in-the-middle (MITM) attacks are possible using the compromised authority key.

workaround.p: There is no known workaround at this time.

resolution.p: All ca-certificates users should upgrade to the latest version:
